description:
# Morph

Full player disguise for your Minecraft server. Made for Nukkit MOT.

**EN:** Disguise as another player (skin, nick, prefix) with a shared profile DB.  
**UK:** Перевтілення в іншого гравця (скін, нік, префікс) зі спільною БД профілів.  
**RU:** Перевоплощение в другого игрока (скин, ник, префикс) с общей БД профилей.

Author: **YehrLB**

## Requirements

- Java 21
- Nukkit MOT

## Build

```bash
mvn -DskipTests package
```

Jar: `target/Morph-1.0.0.jar`  
(put `lib/Nukkit-MOT-SNAPSHOT.jar` locally for compile - not in the repo)

## Quick start

1. Drop jar into `plugins/`
2. Set `profiles-path` in config to any folder you want (same path on all servers if shared)
3. On **lobby** server set `lobby: true` (captures skins/nicks)
4. On **game** servers keep `lobby: false`
5. `/morph <player>` - menu, or `/morph <player> <target>`

## Config (short)

```yaml
language: en   # en | uk | ru
lobby: false
profiles-path: "plugins/Morph/profiles"
persist-across-relog: true
hide-from-server-list: true
```

Languages: `plugins/Morph/lang/`  
In-game: `/morph lang uk`

## Commands

| Command | Permission |
|---------|------------|
| `/morph <player>` | `morph.use` |
| `/morph <player> <target>` | `morph.use` |
| `/morph off <player>` | `morph.use` |
| `/morph lang <en\|uk\|ru>` | `morph.use` |
| Morph others | `morph.manage` |

See [LICENSE](https://github.com/YehrLB/Morph/blob/main/LICENSE) (EN / UK / RU).
